def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Two horizontal bars intersect vertical color markers. Extend each marker
    # upward to the top edge and each horizontal bar across its own row.
    cols=[]
    for c in range(len(g[0])):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(len(g)) if g[r][c]]
        if len(vals)>=2 and len(set(vals))==1:
            cols.append((c,vals[0]))
    # vertical guides are evidenced by repeated marker below horizontal bar
    for c,color in cols:
        for r in range(len(g)):
            if g[r][c]==color or (r < 9 and r<min([rr for rr in range(len(g)) if g[rr][c]==color])):
                if r<9: g[r][c]=color
    # extend horizontal colored bars to fill missing zeros between ends
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        cs=[c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x]
        if len(cs)>=5:
            # contiguous interval between first and last nonzero
            color=max(set(row), key=row.count)
            for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                if row[c]==0: g[r][c]=color
    return g
PY
